chunks: I saw Abā Jaʿfar al-Bāqir عليه السلام while the barber was taking from his beard, so he said: “Round it.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ الْبَاقِرَ: Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام, the person observed in the report
key_terms.الْحَجَّامُ: The barber or one performing trimming
key_terms.دَوِّرْهَا: Shape it in a rounded or even manner
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ: A prominent narrator reporting this hadith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about shaping the beard?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام instructed the barber regarding the shaping of his beard. It reflects personal grooming and outward neatness as part of proper conduct and adornment.
